milestone.title: Raul TUI robustness — drill-in edge cases, panic visibility, truncation correctness

intent.outcome: Raul TUI drill-in paths work under hide_done filtering, latent panics are diagnosable instead of silently exiting 0, text truncation uses char counts not byte counts, co-approval tolerates approve failure, and track lanes omit redundant kind prefixes. Status/Overview focus-key routing (formerly AC-04/S4) is deferred to M91 top-tab layout.

problem.description: A focused audit of raul TUI surfaced robustness bugs M85 defers. (1) Board/Path/Inbox drill-in vs hide_done silently fails for done milestones. (2) TUI panics swallowed in catch_unwind. (3) Byte-vs-char truncation in render.rs, watch.rs, annotation.rs. (4) runner.rs co-approval ? propagates before let _ binding. (5) render_tracks_list redundant [kind] prefix in filtered lanes. Status/Overview Tab and focus-key routing deferred to M91 per CH-87-01.

in_scope: Fix Board/Path/Inbox drill-in to handle hide_done: enter detail by id or search visible_milestones()
Print panic payload to stderr before returning from catch_unwind
Fix byte-vs-char truncation in render.rs annotation preview, watch.rs, annotation.rs list
Fix runner.rs co-approval let _ = ...? idiom — drop ? to tolerate approve failure
Drop redundant [kind] prefix in render_tracks_list rows when lane already filters by kind
out_of_scope: Sidebar data loading, footer accuracy, theme activation, --color flag (covered by M85)
Markdown rendering, icons, progress bars (covered by M86)
Status/Overview Tab and focus-key routing (deferred to M91 — CH-87-01 F-01)
New features beyond these robustness fixes

acceptance_criteria.description: Drilling into a done milestone from the Board (or Path/Inbox) succeeds even when hide_done is enabled. Today enter_milestone_detail indexes visible_milestones() but the position comes from the full vec, so the lookup silently fails for done milestones. Test: set hide_done=true, select a done Board card, press Enter, assert content transitions to MilestoneDetail with the correct milestone id.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: S1 (drill-in by id, hide_done-safe), S2 (panic -> stderr + non-zero), S3 (char-count truncation in render.rs/annotation.rs/watch.rs), S5 (co_approval_approve extracted + tolerate approve failure), S6 (drop redundant [kind] prefix), S7 (full suite green). S4 deferred to M91.

acceptance_criteria.description: A panic inside the TUI event loop prints the panic payload to stderr and exits non-zero, instead of mapping Err(_) => Ok(()) (silent exit 0). Test: inject a panic via a test helper and assert stderr contains the payload and the return is non-zero / an error propagates.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: S1 (drill-in by id, hide_done-safe), S2 (panic -> stderr + non-zero), S3 (char-count truncation in render.rs/annotation.rs/watch.rs), S5 (co_approval_approve extracted + tolerate approve failure), S6 (drop redundant [kind] prefix), S7 (full suite green). S4 deferred to M91.

acceptance_criteria.description: Text truncation uses char count, not byte length. In render.rs annotation preview, watch.rs, and annotation.rs list: a multi-byte body of 50 chars (but >60 bytes) does NOT get ... appended; a body of 70 chars DOES. Test feeds a CJK/em-dash string and asserts the boundary.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: S1 (drill-in by id, hide_done-safe), S2 (panic -> stderr + non-zero), S3 (char-count truncation in render.rs/annotation.rs/watch.rs), S5 (co_approval_approve extracted + tolerate approve failure), S6 (drop redundant [kind] prefix), S7 (full suite green). S4 deferred to M91.

findings.description: M87 AC-03 fixed three truncation sites to be char-safe, but only one (commands/watch.rs:71) calls the existing crate::text::truncate helper. The other two re-implement the same logic inline: commands/annotation.rs:52 ('if body.chars().count() > 50') and tui/render.rs:1073 ('if a.body.chars().count() > 60'). render.rs:673 already calls text::truncate for titles in the SAME FILE, so the inline version is inconsistent with its neighbor. text::truncate already does exactly this (chars().count() check + take + format!("{}..."), with tests including a multi-byte em-dash regression). Fix: replace both inline blocks with crate::text::truncate(body, 50) / truncate(&a.body, 60). Reduces three copies of the truncation contract to one.
findings.author: zcode-review

findings.description: co_approval_approve_tolerates_approve_failure (approval_flow.rs:99-136) calls the extracted helper raul::tui::runner::co_approval_approve directly. It does NOT exercise the original call site in handle_event (runner.rs CoApprovalAction::Approve arm, ~line 516). If someone re-introduces 'let _ = runner.run_raw(approve)?;' at the call site (the exact bug S5 fixed), this test still passes — the regression is uncaught. This is L17 (test against the extracted implementation, not the user-visible event-loop path). Hard to drive the full TUI event loop in a test, so a pragmatic fix is a comment on co_approval_approve documenting that it's the body of the CoApprovalAction::Approve arm and any change to the call site must keep using this helper (or add an integration test). Alternatively, extract the arm to a fn the test can call with a synthetic Event.
findings.author: zcode-review
